subject.title: CLAW-526: Gate public publishes without breaking old CLIs

question: Should ClawScan become the authoritative production promotion gate for pending skill and plugin artifacts under this compatibility model?
rationale: The PR changes which scanner controls public publication and deletion of uploaded artifacts; tests cannot decide whether that security boundary and the old-CLI semantic tradeoff match maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve after hardening and proof
options.body: Require immutable ClawScan integrity verification plus production-like lifecycle and old-CLI upgrade proof before enabling staged publication.

options.title: Accept the current scanner installation
options.body: Approve the version-only npm installation and intentionally own its dependency-resolution and operational risks.

options.title: Pause the scanner cutover
options.body: Keep the existing production scanner path until the ClawScan trust, rollout, and compatibility contract is specified separately.

recommendation.title: Approve after hardening and proof
recommendation.body: Require immutable ClawScan integrity verification plus production-like lifecycle and old-CLI upgrade proof before enabling staged publication.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across the staged publish implementation, scanner worker, workflow, and validation surfaces.
